messages.subject: Update ggvis plot using linked_brush
parts:
As the title suggests, I'm creating plots with ggvis that are embedded in a shiny app. After plotting, I would like to zoom in on a selected region that has been chosen with a linked brush. I am almost there, but I can't get the plot to update when I select a region even though I know the region is being correctly selected (based on printing it's output). I'm quite new to shiny so apologize for any obvious mistakes.

Here is the jist of the server.r. The problem is in the data_plot function not reacting to updated values for subset_rows





library(shiny)
library(ggvis)


shinyServer(function(input, output, session){


  #read in data
 
  data <- reactive({
   
    inFile <- input$file
   
    if (is.null(inFile)) return(NULL)
   
    read.delim(inFile$datapath, header=T, as.is=T)
   
  })
 
  
  # For selecting the zoomable region

  subset_rows <- reactiveValues()
 

  # plot data
 
  data_plot <- reactive({

      tmp.data = data()
   
      subset <- subset_rows
      if(length(subset) > 1){                                     #check if something other than NULL has been assigned
        tmp.data = data[data$ID %in% subset,]
      }

     tmp.data
     
    }
  })

 
  #create linked brush and update subset_rows
 
  lb <- linked_brush(keys = seq_len(nrow(data_plot())), "red")
 
  observeEvent(input$zoom, {                            # I have a "zoom" button in ui.r that needs to be clicked for zooming to occur

    selected <- lb$selected
    if(!any(selected())) {
      select_rows <- c();
    } else{
      select_data <- data_plot()[selected(), ]
      select_rows <- select_data$ID
    }
   
  })
   
  observe({
   
    selected_data <- data_plot()
   
    selected_data %>%
     ggvis(~x, ~y) %>%
     layer_points(fill.brush := "red") %>%
     lb$input() %>%
     bind_shiny("plot", "lot_ui")
   
  })

})
